baseline.ui_default: Baseline fixed before metrics are observed

candidate.model: Fixed Elo expected-score plus earlier-data draw frequency
candidate.parameter_selection: Declared fixed heuristic; no accuracy/optimality claim; no tuning on evaluation season

chronology.elo_updates: Compute day-end rating deltas from pre-day ratings; no team appears twice per day in verified input
chronology.prediction_uses: Only matches whose date is strictly earlier than predicted match date
chronology.same_date: Predict entire date batch before updating any model state
chronology.season_carry: Carry history across seasons; an unseen club starts at initial Elo; no full-season outcome aggregates used as input
chronology.times: Ignored because source time zones/order not independently verified
chronology.training_provenance: Each prediction records training count and latest training date, plus contributing earlier match IDs

coverage_and_limits: Reject malformed, unscored or duplicate match inputs rather than silently changing data
Only source scores/dates/teams are available; no injury, player rest, xG or tracking claims
Data structure verified; actual league results not independently reconciled
Model-relative context for choosing match review, not causal difficulty, true skill or a forecast guarantee

evaluation.model_selection: No automatic switch of UI default based on held-out loss; candidate comparison remains visible even if worse
evaluation.report: Both baseline and candidate on every eligible held-out match; report n and candidate-minus-baseline loss

form_window.insufficient_history: Explicitly unavailable until five observations; no padding with future results
form_window.matches: Last five completed domestic league appearances as of selected date
form_window.population: Show all eligible club windows, not hand-picked success cases
form_window.residual: Actual points minus pre-match expected points
form_window.sensitivity: Five leave-one-out mean residuals, each using four games; report min/max against full five-game mean

input_seasons.score_fields: Final scores only; no odds, injury, xG or tracking data
Final scores only; no odds, injury, xG or tracking data
